title: Judges at a painting contest
body: Five paintings (P, Q, R, S, T) in a school art contest were ranked by three judges, X, Y and Z, with rank 1 for the best painting. Judge X ranked them P = 1, Q = 2, R = 3, S = 4, T = 5. Judge Y ranked them P = 5, Q = 4, R = 3, S = 2, T = 1. Judge Z ranked them P = 2, Q = 1, R = 4, S = 3, T = 5. The organisers want to know which pair of judges shares the most similar idea of a good painting, using Spearman's rank correlation coefficient r = 1 - 6(sum of D squared)/(n cubed - n), where D is the difference between the two ranks given to the same painting and n is the number of paintings.
